New households per year, by source
note: Between censuses households are consent-derived, so the relationship in a is partly mechanical (housing supply meets migration). b: households per previous-year consent vary before 2019 and are 0.885–0.889 from 2019: these years are estimated from consents and are not independent evidence. c: history one column per census interval (interval means; households census-anchored at both ends), stacked from population growth and from household-size change; 2024–2025 faint (consent-derived estimates, no census check); projection annual, faded, from 2026; the line is the net of the two parts. A negative part (household-size change, where households grow larger) is drawn as an outlined segment hanging from the top of the stack, so each column ends at its net total (short tick).
